title: Property Consultant
description:
**Company Description**

RED | Real Estate Domain (KW RED) is the first market center to partner with KW Egypt, operating as a respected real estate brokerage known for integrity, professionalism, and client-focused service. The company has built a strong industry reputation by prioritizing transparent transactions and long-term relationships. A dedicated team of experts supports clients in achieving their real estate goals through data-driven decisions and innovative technology. By adapting to changing market dynamics, RED consistently delivers exceptional results and seamless real estate experiences. The company positions itself as a trusted partner for clients across all their real estate endeavors.

**Role Description**

The Property Consultant is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This position focuses on guiding clients through the property buying, selling, and leasing process, including conducting property viewings, preparing and presenting offers, and supporting negotiations. Day-to-day responsibilities include maintaining a portfolio of listings, researching market trends, and providing informed recommendations to help clients make data-driven decisions. The Property Consultant will handle client inquiries, build and maintain strong relationships, and ensure a professional and seamless experience from initial contact through closing. The role also involves collaborating with internal teams, using real estate technology tools, and meeting agreed sales and performance targets.

**Qualifications**

* Strong consulting skills to assess client needs, provide tailored property advice, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Excellent communication abilities for clear presentations, negotiations, and relationship-building with clients and colleagues.
* Proven customer service capabilities to ensure a responsive, professional, and client-centric real estate experience.
* Sales experience, including lead generation, pipeline management, and closing transactions in a competitive market.
* Foundational real estate knowledge of local market trends, property valuation, legal processes, and documentation.
* Ability to work on-site in Cairo, Egypt, with strong time management, organization, and attention to detail.
* Comfort with using real estate CRM systems and digital tools to track leads, properties, and client interactions.
* Relevant academic background or professional certifications in real estate, business, or a related field are advantageous.
* Fluency in English and Arabic, both written and spoken, is highly beneficial.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

We are looking for a **Senior System Engineer** to join our team in **Noida**.

The Senior Systems Engineer provides additional hands-on engineering capacity and end-to-end ownership for critical infrastructure, security platforms, and enterprise services. The role designs, implements, maintains, and improves resilient, secure, and supportable technology solutions across cloud and on-premises environments. Working closely with IT Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, application teams, and service owners, the engineer translates operational and project requirements into practical technical solutions and drives work from design through deployment and ongoing support.

This is a delivery and ownership focused role that increases capacity across infrastructure and security initiatives, accelerates modernization, and reduces technical debt, lifecycle-management gaps, and remediation backlogs. The engineer establishes clear operational ownership, improves monitoring and recovery readiness, standardizes repeatable engineering practices, and resolves complex service issues. By expanding senior-level engineering coverage and reducing dependency on a limited number of key resources, the role enables architects and senior leaders to spend more time on architecture, governance, security, and strategic priorities rather than routine operational work.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain critical infrastructure, security platforms, and enterprise services across cloud and on-premises environments. Convert approved requirements and architecture standards into secure, reliable, and supportable production solutions.

* Take end-to-end technical ownership for assigned platforms and services, including configuration standards, documentation, monitoring, patching, upgrades, capacity planning, vendor coordination, incident support, lifecycle planning, and continuous improvement.

* Increase delivery capacity across infrastructure and security initiatives by leading or executing technical work packages, resolving dependencies, coordinating testing and change activities, and completing operational handover with service owners and support teams.

* Accelerate modernization and reduce technical debt by identifying aging, unsupported, overly complex, or manually administered technologies; developing practical remediation or replacement plans; and implementing standardized, automated, and maintainable solutions.

* Reduce lifecycle-management and remediation backlogs by assessing platform health, prioritizing work based on operational and security risk, coordinating maintenance windows, and completing upgrades, patching, configuration remediation, and technology refresh activities.

* Improve operational resilience by engineering platforms for availability, recoverability, scalability, and secure operation. Establish monitoring, alerting, backup, recovery, and failover requirements; validate procedures through testing; and address identified gaps.

* Automate repeatable infrastructure and operational tasks using scripting, configuration management, infrastructure as code, and orchestration tools. Maintain version-controlled code, technical standards, reusable modules, and tested deployment and rollback procedures.

* Troubleshoot complex incidents and recurring service issues using logs, metrics, traces, platform telemetry, and root-cause analysis. Implement corrective actions, document known errors and recovery procedures, and reduce repeated manual intervention.

* Engineer and operate services in alignment with approved security requirements. Apply least privilege, secure configuration, secrets and certificate management, vulnerability remediation, logging, segmentation, and access-control standards; identify and escalate exceptions or material risks.

* Improve team coverage and reduce key-person dependency by creating current architecture diagrams, build standards, inventories, operating procedures, support runbooks, and knowledge articles. Crosstrain colleagues and ensure critical services have effective primary and secondary support coverage.

* Partner with Architecture, Security, Service Management, application teams, and business stakeholders to evaluate technical options, explain tradeoffs, sequence work, and ensure solutions meet operational, security, compliance, and business requirements.

* Provide technical leadership during projects and operational changes by reviewing designs, identifying implementation risks, mentoring engineers, and promoting consistent engineering, documentation, testing, and change-management practices.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **Systems engineering experience:** 10+ years of progressively responsible experience across systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, enterprise platforms, or security infrastructure, with demonstrated ownership of production services and delivery of maintainable technical solutions.

* **Platform ownership:** Demonstrated experience assuming end-to-end technical ownership for critical services, including design, implementation, operational support, monitoring, lifecycle management, documentation, risk remediation, vendor engagement, and continuous improvement.

* **Cloud and on-premises infrastructure:** Strong hands-on experience with enterprise cloud and data-center technologies, including compute, storage, virtualization, networking, DNS, load balancing, backup, identity integration, and high-availability design. Practical experience with at least one major cloud platform.

* **Microsoft enterprise technologies:** Strong working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, endpoint and server management, PowerShell, certificates, authentication, and related enterprise administration and troubleshooting practices.

* **Linux and heterogeneous environments:** Working knowledge of Linux administration and the ability to support and troubleshoot services that span multiple operating systems, network zones, cloud services, and third-party platforms.

* **Automation and infrastructure as code:** Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or comparable languages. Experience with configuration management, infrastructure as code, APIs, source control, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices.

* **Security engineering fundamentals:** Practical experience implementing secure configuration, least privilege, privileged access controls, vulnerability and patch remediation, secrets and certificate management, audit logging, network security controls, and security monitoring requirements.

* **Lifecycle and technical-debt management:** Experience assessing platform health, supportability, dependencies, and end-of-life risk; building remediation plans; and executing upgrades, migrations, consolidation, decommissioning, and backlog-reduction work without disrupting critical services.

* **Operational resilience:** Experience designing and operating highly available services, defining service dependencies and recovery requirements, implementing monitoring and alerting, and validating backup, recovery, failover, and continuity procedures.

* **Production operations and troubleshooting:** Advanced ability to diagnose complex, multi-system issues using logs, metrics, traces, packet or protocol analysis, and structured root-cause analysis. Experience with incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management processes.

* **Documentation and knowledge transfer:** Ability to create accurate architecture diagrams, technical standards, build documentation, inventories, runbooks, recovery procedures, and knowledge articles, and to transfer operational knowledge effectively across the team.

* **Project delivery and collaboration:** Ability to translate business, architecture, security, and operational requirements into practical engineering plans; manage dependencies and implementation risks; and work effectively across Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, Service Management, application teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.

* **Engineering judgment and independence:** Ability to work independently within approved architecture and governance, prioritize competing operational and project demands, make sound technical decisions, escalate material risks, and select the simplest supportable solution that meets the requirement.

**Preferred / Beneficial Experience**

* Experience with Microsoft Azure and related identity, networking, monitoring, governance, and security services; relevant experience with AWS or another major cloud platform is also beneficial.

* Experience with enterprise security and access platforms such as endpoint detection and response, secure access service edge, vulnerability or exposure management, privileged access management, identity governance, certificate management, or centralized logging and monitoring.

* Experience with virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, serverless platforms, configuration-management tools, and infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, or Ansible.

* Experience leading platform modernization, cloud migration, data-center consolidation, operating-system or application upgrades, technology decommissioning, or large-scale remediation programs.

* Experience improving service resilience through monitoring modernization, backup and recovery improvements, disaster-recovery testing, dependency mapping, capacity planning, and elimination of single points of failure.

* Relevant Microsoft, Azure, AWS, Linux, networking, security, IT service management, automation, or DevOps certifications, or equivalent demonstrated practical experience.

title: Penetration Tester ( Security Analayst) , 3+ yrs
description:
Location UAE & Koratty,India

**Work Mode: WFO until probation; Hybrid after confirmation**

As a Security Analyst specializing in Web Penetration Testing, you will assist in identifying vulnerabilities and assessing the security posture of web applications. You will work closely with senior team members to enhance your skills, perform web penetration testing, and contribute to delivering high-quality security assessments.

* Assist in performing web application penetration tests (both manual and automated) on internal and external web applications.
* Identify, exploit, and document web vulnerabilities (e.g., SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, etc.) under guidance.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments using automated web application testing tools like OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, and other relevant tools.
* Analyze web application architectures and workflows to identify security risks.
* Document findings, security weaknesses, and suggested remediation steps in detailed reports.
* Collaborate with senior team members to refine findings and deliver professional-grade reports to clients.
* Utilize tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nikto, and Nmap for web security testing.
* Ensure that testing tools and systems are kept up-to-date to ensure efficiency and coverage of emerging vulnerabilities.
* Stay updated with the latest web security threats, exploits, and penetration testing techniques.
* Participate in internal training sessions, contribute to team knowledge sharing, and expand your knowledge of web application security.
* Follow industry standards such as OWASP Top 10, PTES, and other relevant guidelines during assessments.
* Adhere to internal and client-specific security policies, ensuring compliance with industry best practices and security regulations.

**Key Skills**

* Basic understanding of web application security concepts and common vulnerabilities.
* Familiarity with web penetration testing tools like Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nikto, and others.
* Knowledge of common web application attack vectors (e.g., SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)).
* Ability to analyze and identify vulnerabilities in web technologies (e.g., HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, APIs).
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to document findings clearly and concisely.
* Willingness to stay up-to-date with the latest trends in web security and penetration testing.
* Experience with basic web security testing or bug bounty programs.
* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and web security best practices.
* Exposure to common web technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Node.js).
* Familiarity with basic network security tools like Wireshark, Nmap, and others.

 **Certifications such as CEH, OSCP, OSWA, CRTO, CREST CRT/CCT, or similar are preferred.**

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume to lidiya@affable.in or contact 9539450003

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Koratti, Thrissur, Kerala

title: Project Coordinator
description:
The Professional Services Team is looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support the planning, execution, and governance of customer implementation projects within our Professional Services organization and successful delivery of Basware software solutions and services for our global customers. This role supports Project Managers (PMs), Solution Consultants, Architects, and cross-functional teams in ensuring predictable delivery of B2B SaaS implementation projects.
  
  
You will play a critical role in project documentation, scheduling, reporting, risk tracking, customer communication, and operational support—contributing directly to our customers’ onboarding and value realization journey.
  
  
In this capacity, you will help maintain project health, streamline communication, and uphold delivery discipline aligned with our Professional Services methodology
  
  

* Flexible shift timings\*

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist Project Managers in executing end-to-end SaaS implementation projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and delivery methodology
* Create and maintain detailed project schedules, calendars, action item lists, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), and project documentation
* Coordinate cross-functional activities between Professional Services, Product, Customer Success, Technical Support, and Sales
* Facilitate internal and customer-facing project meetings, document minutes, and track follow-up tasks
* Act as a secondary point of contact for customers during project execution, supporting PMs in managing communications and expectations
* Maintain accurate project data in project management systems (e.g., Jira, Salesforce, MS Project, Kantata)
* Prepare weekly project status reports, dashboards, metrics (milestones, effort consumption, resource utilization).
* Track and escalate delivery risks, blockers, and dependencies to the Project Manager early, supporting mitigation planning.
* Help in ensuring SOWs, change requests, and contractual obligations are documented and adhered to
* Coordinate with Solution Consultants, Architects, and Support to ensure seamless handover into production support or Customer Success

,
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, Engineering, Project Management, or related field
* 3–5 years of experience in project coordination, client delivery, or operations within B2B SaaS, IT Services, or Professional Services organizations
* Experience supporting cross-functional delivery teams in matrix and global environments
* Good understanding of project management concepts (waterfall, Agile, hybrid).
* Ability to interpret project plans, timelines, and capacity/resource plans.
* Familiarity with SaaS delivery concepts—APIs, integrations, configuration cycles, UAT, deployment.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) for reporting and documentation.
* Experience with AI tools, frameworks, or applications is considered a strong asset.
* We highly value candidates who demonstrate curiosity, a proactive mindset, and a willingness to explore and incorporate AI-driven technologies into their work. We encourage growth in this area and provide opportunities for experimentation and learning.

title: UX Designer
description:
**Job Description**
**JD - UX Designer Contractor (7-10 yrs)**
This role supports the design of intuitive, high‑quality user interfaces across desktop, tablet, and native mobile platforms throughout the implementation lifecycle. It involves creating wireframes, iterative mockups, and UX/UI deliverables grounded in human‑centered design principles and insights from UX research to help articulate the intended user experience. The role ensures designs align with brand standards, the internal design system, and the end‑to‑end user journey. Working closely with Senior Designers, Product owners, researchers, content strategists, and business and technology partners, this role supports discovery and solution development efforts. It helps translate business and user needs into clear UX documentation, stories, and acceptance criteria within Agile teams, and presents design work and rationale with guidance from senior designers and UX leaders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design of experiences during the implementation phase of the project, including the development of wireframes, mock-ups and other project deliverables to illustrate the intended user experience.
* Design interactive user interfaces for complex mobile app journeys and f amiliarity working within design systems and its application to mobile environments.
* Present design ideas, including rationale based on research and best practices, to the product development team and other key stakeholders.
* Participate in peer design reviews/critique, giving and receiving constructive feedback.
* Present design ideas, including rationale based on research and best practices, to the product development team and other key stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required.
* 7-10 years of relevant experience required.
* Knowledge of human-centered design process, web best-practices and relevant disciplines, including information architecture, interaction and visual design.
* Proficient with design tools, design thinking, systems thinking, and agile methodology
* Experience working with industry standard visualization tools and software (e.g. Figma, Sketch, Mural, Adobe Creative Suite, etc.).
* Understanding of mobile interaction patterns (gestures, navigation models, touch targets)
* Experience designing for different screen sizes, orientations, and device capabilities
* Familiarity with app performance, loading states, motion, and responsiveness considerations
* Knowledge of accessibility standards for mobile (WCAG AA/AAA)
* Proficient prototyping and mockup skills to convey ideas and concepts.
* Strong written and verbal communications skills, including the ability to clearly articulate creative concepts and rationale.
* Working knowledge of design fundamentals such as color theory, composition, branding, typography and web design standards.
* Ability to work in both waterfall and agile project processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A portfolio of professional UX design experience for digital products or services.
* Experience with user centered principles and techniques including design sprints, co-creation methods, behavioural design and research, service design and research.
* Experience designing transactional or complex interactions with consumer and/or B2B platforms.
* Ability to interpret product requirements documents from a user-centered perspective.
* Working knowledge of usability testing and other research methods.
* Working knowledge of basic HTML/CSS and experience inspecting and validating QA/test environments
* Experience working with industry standard data visualization tools and software, including Tableau, High Charts, Power BI, etc.
